jobs.title: Jr. Multimedia Artist

Contribute creative concepts and execution ideas. Maintain brand consistency and apply creative feedback. Make layout, editing, motion, and production decisions within the approved brief and brand guidelines. Work with the Design Lead to refine outputs and align on new directions or significant changes. Ensure quality and organize final files. Check work against approved copy, brand standards, and technical specifications before submission. Keep editable files and final exports organized and ready for handoff.
